data.name: 聖剣レイヴランシル物語＆聖剣レイヴランシル物語+(Plus) episode1,2,3
data.detailed_description:
What Will the Holy Sword Lead You To?

The hero Harold and his companions take up the Holy Sword Raveranciel.

Beyond their battles against powerful enemies lie the mysteries hidden within the sword and a destiny intertwined with light and darkness.

Holy Sword Raveranciel Story is an epic fantasy RPG centered on a legendary holy sword.

Alongside the main story, the game features the Holy Sword Raveranciel Story + (Plus) Episode series, which explores the lives of different characters.

There is more to this world than the story of a single hero. As you follow the journeys of various characters, the world of Raveranciel gradually unfolds.

What awaits beyond the destiny guided by the holy sword?

Experience Harold's adventures and the individual stories of those who walk their own paths.

■ An Original Fantasy Adventure Uncovering the Secrets of the Holy Sword

Throughout their battles against powerful foes, Harold and his companions encounter unexpected truths.

What are their enemies plotting? What secrets does the holy sword conceal?

As your adventure unfolds, the mysteries woven throughout the story gradually come to light.

A destiny shaped by the holy sword. A tale of light and darkness.

Discover the truth for yourself through your own adventure.

■ Individual Lives, Interwoven into One Story

The + (Plus) Episode series tells the stories of different protagonists, each with their own life, challenges, and adventures beyond the main story.

Episode 1: Therese Mason

Follow Therese, a warrior who walks her own path. Experience another side of the world through her eyes.

Episode 2: Marsha A. Regine

Follow Marsha as she faces trials involving magic and strives to regain her lost power.

Episode 3: Lucius Shano

A mysterious dream sets Lucius on a journey to investigate an unusual disturbance surrounding the holy sword.

Every character has a story of their own.

Rather than following a single hero, discover the world through the lives of people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

As their paths cross, the world of Raveranciel expands, revealing new layers of its story.

■ Fight Your Own Way or Let Auto-Battle Take Over

During combat, you can choose your actions manually or leave the fighting to the auto-battle system.

Plan your own tactics and take on your enemies, or let battles unfold while you focus on the story.

Enjoy your adventure in a way that suits your playstyle.

■ This Game Is for You If You Enjoy

  • RPGs set in original fantasy worlds

  • Stories filled with the mysteries of a holy sword and the conflict between light and darkness

  • Stories that explore the lives of many characters, not just a single protagonist

  • Games whose worlds and stories expand across multiple episodes

  • The flexibility of choosing between manual combat and auto-battle

  • Long-running fantasy adventures set in a richly developed world

■ Enter the World of the Holy Sword Raveranciel

Harold and his companions embark on their adventure.

Therese, Marsha, and Lucius each follow their own paths and face their own destinies.

In time, their individual stories become intertwined with a much greater tale surrounding the Holy Sword Raveranciel.

The mysteries hidden within the holy sword. A destiny shaped by light and darkness.

What will the holy sword lead you to?

Discover the world of Raveranciel and uncover its story through your own adventure.

data.short_description: The Holy Sword Raveranciel hides a secret rooted in the past. After completing the main story, unlock the + (Plus) Episode series and follow the journeys of four companions across five episodes. Episodes 4 & 5 are scheduled for release in late November or early December 2026, completing the series.
